interface.signature: def solve(N, A, edges, queries) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 20.
The number of nodes N in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.
The number of queries Q in each test case is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= A_i <= 100 for all i in range(1, N+1)
preconditions.description: Each node value A_i is an integer between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u, v <= N and u != v for all edges (u, v)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a, b <= N and a != b for all queries (a, b)
preconditions.description: Each query involves two distinct nodes within the valid range.
The input contains exactly N-1 edges, forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The result list contains exactly one answer per query.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= answer <= 99 for answer in result)
postconditions.description: Each answer is a non-negative integer between 0 and 99 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(any(abs(A[x-1] - A[y-1]) == answer for x in path for y in path if x != y) for answer, path in zip(result, [get_path(a-1, b-1, edges) for a, b in queries]))
postconditions.description: For each query (a, b), the answer is the minimum absolute difference between any two distinct node values on the path between a and b.
